name: get_status
title: Status and what needs attention
description: What is broken and needs the owner (needs_attention), every source's status (the twin, mail, RUZ, HSE App X, sheets, grades, images) and today's LLM spending against the limit.

name: list_deadlines
title: Deadlines
description: The one merged list of deadlines (HSE App X, RUZ midterms, chats, mail, own ones), as the web app and Tablo show it, in screen order. Each item has a uid (for the change tools), title, due date, category (study/personal), source, course, overdue, and for chats and mail the chat and the message (chat, msg) it came from. `own` lists the owner's own deadlines.

name: list_hidden_deadlines
title: Hidden deadlines
description: Deadlines of the sources the owner hid for good; unhide_deadline brings one back.

name: get_timetable
title: Timetable
description: The timetable as the calendar feeds have it: RUZ classes with their changes, events from chats and mail, own events, by day. Each item has uid, title, start, end, type, room, required (main or optional calendar), cancelled, source, and `event`: the event or correction behind it (its id is what edit_event, set_event_options and remove_event take). hidden_events: events hidden from the feeds.

start.description: the first day, YYYY-MM-DD; today when left out

name: list_news
title: News
description: Live news parsed from the chats and mail, ranked: importance 1-5, study or not, full and short text, and the chat and message ids it was made of.

hours.description: how old at most, in hours; by default how long news lives (news_ttl_hours)

name: search_messages
title: Search messages
description: Raw messages of the enabled chats and letters of the mailbox (chat_id 0), newest first. They are kept 14 days. Filter by text (any case), chat and days.

text.description: words the text or the letter's subject contains

chat_id.description: one chat (list_chats gives the ids; 0 is the mailbox)

name: get_message
title: One message
description: A message as the twin read it (chat_id 0: a letter), with the message it answers, its link and its chat; the page a source link of a deadline or event opens (D50).

name: list_chats
title: Chats and their settings
description: Every chat of the twin's account with its settings (enabled, study, filter, people, images, pdf_content, urgent, batch_hours, note), stored message counts, and the twin's, mail's and images' status.

name: list_chat_senders
title: People of a chat
description: Who wrote in a chat, most active first: ids for `people`.

name: list_courses
title: Course dictionary
description: The course dictionary: a source's course name → short English title and abbreviation (the prefix of deadline labels). manual: set by the owner, Haiku never overwrites it.

name: get_settings
title: Settings
description: Every setting «Machine» shows, without the secrets: batches, news life, languages, what the student told the models (about_me), reminders, images a day, whole-PDF limits, grades, the LLM limit and spending (read only).

name: list_sheets
title: Problem sheets
description: Problem sheets found in the chats or uploaded, newest first, with course, number (or a title), due date, summary, versions, and the limits of reading a PDF whole.

name: get_sheet
title: One problem sheet
description: A sheet's details and the text of its pages as read locally (empty for a scan). With first_page_image, a scanned first page comes as an image while the file is kept (14 days).

name: list_grades
title: Grades
description: The gradebooks (Google Sheets) with every grade read, 0-10, the grades added by hand, and `new`: the new grades of the window.

name: get_gradebook
title: One gradebook
description: A gradebook's last read and every tab with its layout: which column is which work, the own row's cells, and whose the layout is (Haiku's or the owner's).

sheet_id.description: the gradebook's id, from list_grades: sheets[].id

name: hide_news
title: Hide a news item
description: Take a news item off the news list, the web app and Tablo; it stays hidden when its message is edited.

name: add_deadline
title: Add a deadline
description: A new own deadline.

course.description: the course's abbreviation (list_courses), for its lens in the web app

name: edit_deadline
title: Change a deadline
description: Change the title, due date or list of a deadline. An own one changes; one from a source is hidden and an own copy with the change takes its place.

uid.description: the deadline's uid, as list_deadlines gives it (items[].uid or own[].uid)

name: hide_deadline
title: Hide a deadline
description: Hide a deadline of a source (a chat, mail, HSE App X, RUZ) for good, even if the source sends it again. reason, if known: done (handed in), not_mine (not the owner's work), duplicate (the same work as `kept`, which stays).

uid.description: the deadline's uid, as list_deadlines gives it (items[].uid or own[].uid)

kept.description: of a duplicate: the uid of the deadline that stays

name: confirm_deadline_date
title: Confirm an assumed date
description: A sheet's due date the service assumed (assumed: true, its course's next seminar) is right: it becomes the real date and stops following the timetable.

uid.description: the deadline's uid, as list_deadlines gives it (items[].uid or own[].uid)

name: set_deadline_course
title: Set a deadline's course
description: The course of a deadline from a chat, a letter or RUZ, for one that has none or a wrong one. course: a name of the course dictionary (list_courses) or the timetable's.

uid.description: the deadline's uid, as list_deadlines gives it (items[].uid or own[].uid)

name: delete_deadline
title: Delete an own deadline
description: Delete one of the owner's own deadlines.

uid.description: the deadline's uid, as list_deadlines gives it (items[].uid or own[].uid)

name: unhide_deadline
title: Restore a hidden deadline
description: Bring back a hidden deadline, if its source still has it.

name: add_event
title: Add an event
description: A new own event in the timetable and the calendar feeds.

kind.description: the type: Event, Consultation, Exam, Lecture, Seminar…

start.description: Moscow local time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or a date YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event (then no end)

end.description: Moscow local time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, after the start; null for an all-day event

room.description: a room or a meeting link

required.description: the main calendar (true, default) or the optional one

name: edit_event
title: Change an event
description: Change an event of a chat, the mail or the owner (not a RUZ class: correct_class). Give start and end together. A chat's event is hidden and an own copy with the change takes its place.

event_id.description: the event's id, from get_timetable: items[].event.id, or hidden_events[].id

kind.description: the type: Event, Consultation, Exam, Lecture, Seminar…

start.description: Moscow local time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or a date YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event (then no end)

end.description: Moscow local time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, after the start; null for an all-day event

room.description: a room or a meeting link

name: set_event_options
title: Hide or move an event between calendars
description: hidden: out of the feeds (true) or back (false); a hidden correction of a class is not applied. required: the main calendar (true) or the optional one (false); a class is always in the main one.

event_id.description: the event's id, from get_timetable: items[].event.id, or hidden_events[].id

annotations.title: Hide or move an event between calendars

name: remove_event
title: Remove an own event
description: Delete an own event, take back an own change of a class (the chat's change or RUZ applies again) or take back an own copy of a chat's event (the chat's one is back). A chat's event is hidden instead, with set_event_options.

event_id.description: the event's id, from get_timetable: items[].event.id, or hidden_events[].id

name: correct_class
title: Move, cancel or change a class
description: The owner's change of a RUZ class: a new time, room, title, type or calendar, or cancelled. It stands over RUZ and the chats until removed with remove_event.

class_uid.description: the class's uid, from get_timetable: items[].uid of a class (source ruz)

room.description: a room or a meeting link

kind.description: the type: Event, Consultation, Exam, Lecture, Seminar…

annotations.title: Move, cancel or change a class

name: update_chat_settings
title: Change a chat's settings
description: Change some settings of a chat; the others stay. Turning a chat on makes its messages read from now.

study.description: a study chat: its news counts as study

filter.description: important: only the people listed in `people` are read

people.description: Telegram user ids of the important people (list_chat_senders gives them)

images.description: Haiku reads photos and screenshots of the chat

pdf_content.description: PDFs of the chat are read whole (problem sheets)

urgent.description: a new message starts a batch at once

batch_hours.description: the chat's own batch period in hours; null: the general one

note.description: what the chat is about, for the models

name: set_course
title: Set a dictionary entry
description: Add or change a course in the dictionary by hand: the source's name, a short English title, an abbreviation of at most 6 characters. A manual entry is never overwritten by Haiku.

name.description: the course as the sources name it

name: delete_course
title: Delete a dictionary entry
description: Drop a course from the dictionary; Haiku names it again when a source brings it.

name: update_general_settings
title: Change general settings
description: Batches every N hours, how long news lives, the language of the app (en, ru), what the student tells the models about themselves (group, subgroup, electives), and the course wiki pages whose new sheets and homework come as notices in the mailbox (the whole list, addresses).

name: update_images
title: Change images read a day
description: How many images a day Haiku reads in chats with images on; 0 reads none.

name: update_notifications
title: Change the web app's notifications
description: Which kinds the web app pushes to the owner's devices (deadlines: new and moved; reminders; failures: a source failed or needs a login; llm: the daily limit spent), and the quiet hours (Moscow, HH:MM-HH:MM, '' for none) when they come without a sound.

name: update_reminders
title: Change deadline reminders
description: Deadline reminders pushed to the web app: on or off, the eve's time and the day's time (Moscow, HH:MM).

name: edit_sheet
title: Change a problem sheet
description: The course, number (or a short title for a sheet without one), due date or summary of a sheet; the caption of its message follows. An empty course or a null due clears it.

number.description: the number ("3"), or a short title instead, up to 60

name: delete_sheet
title: Delete an own sheet
description: An own sheet (one the owner uploaded) with every version. It cannot be undone; a chat's sheet is refused.

name: join_sheet
title: Join a sheet to another as its newer version
description: A sheet that was posted as new becomes the newer version of another sheet (sheet_id of list_sheets, the newer one first). It cannot be undone.

sheet_id.description: the sheet that becomes a newer version

annotations.title: Join a sheet to another as its newer version

name: update_pdf_limits
title: Change the limits of whole PDFs
description: For chats with pdf_content: how many pages and tokens of one PDF are read, whichever comes first.

annotations.title: Change the limits of whole PDFs

name: update_grade_settings
title: Change grade settings
description: student: the name the own row is found by in every gradebook (changing it reads them all again from scratch); window_days: how long a grade counts as new.

name: add_gradebook
title: Add a gradebook
description: A teacher's Google Sheet open to anyone with the link; label: the course's short name in front of its grades (empty: the start of the sheet's title); name: the owner's name for it.

name: remove_gradebook
title: Remove a gradebook
description: Stop reading a gradebook; its grades are forgotten.

sheet_id.description: the gradebook's id, from list_grades: sheets[].id

name: update_gradebook
title: Rename a gradebook
description: The owner's name of a gradebook, or its course label.

sheet_id.description: the gradebook's id, from list_grades: sheets[].id

name: read_gradebook_now
title: Read the gradebooks now
description: Read the gradebooks at once instead of in 30 minutes.

sheet_id.description: the gradebook's id, from list_grades: sheets[].id

name: set_tab_layout
title: Lay out a gradebook tab
description: The owner's layout of a tab, over Haiku's: skip it, or which column of the own row is which work. get_gradebook shows the columns.

sheet_id.description: the gradebook's id, from list_grades: sheets[].id

tab.description: the tab's name, from get_gradebook: tabs[].tab

column.description: a column letter of the own row

name: reset_tab_layout
title: Give a tab back to Haiku
description: Drop the owner's layout of a tab.

sheet_id.description: the gradebook's id, from list_grades: sheets[].id

tab.description: the tab's name, from get_gradebook: tabs[].tab

annotations.title: Give a tab back to Haiku

name: add_grade
title: Add a grade by hand
description: A grade the gradebooks do not have.

name: change_grade
title: Change a grade
description: Change a grade added by hand, or correct a gradebook's grade (the correction holds until the sheet changes the grade itself).

name: delete_grade
title: Delete or reset a grade
description: Delete a grade added by hand, or bring a corrected gradebook grade back to the sheet's value.

name: list_library
title: Library overview
description: The library's courses with their counts (items, new items not yet made into the knowledge base, published documents), how many items wait in the inbox for a course, and the disk used.

name: list_materials
title: Raw materials
description: Raw items, newest first: of the inbox (inbox: true; items whose course is not known, to sort with sort_material), of a course, of one class, or all. Each item without its long text: kind, title, author, day, course, class_uid, status (new: not yet in the knowledge base; processed), the file's name, type and size, a link's url, a short preview, and for a recording the ids of its transcripts. get_material gives the whole item.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

class_uid.description: a RUZ class of the course, from list_classes: classes[].uid

name: get_material
title: One raw item
description: One item whole: the text of a text, notes, a transcript or a link's words (a long one in pages: offset, max_chars); the text of a PDF's pages; a photo inline as an image when it is a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP of at most 3.75 MB (image: false leaves it out); download_url, a signed link of 24 hours, for any file (Claude Code: curl -o <file> '<download_url>'); its class; the items hanging on it (a recording's transcripts).

id.description: the item's id, from list_materials: items[].id

offset.description: the character a long text starts at: next_offset of the previous call; 0 by default

max_chars.description: characters of text at most, 30000 by default

name: list_classes
title: Classes of a course
description: A course's RUZ classes that have started, the last first: uid, start, end, kind (lecture, seminar, or empty for an exam), counts of its items (new: not yet processed), and the documents made for it. Also the course's own documents (book, cheat sheet) and how many items have no class.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

name: list_documents
title: Knowledge base documents
description: The published documents of the knowledge base (of one course, or all): a book per course, a lecture or a seminar per class, a cheat sheet per course, and the guide over all of them (its course empty); each with its newest version, when it was published and what changed.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

name: get_document
title: One document
description: A document's versions, and of one version (the newest by default) the source inline (LaTeX; Markdown for a cheat sheet and the guide; a long one in pages: offset, max_chars) with signed links of 24 hours to its source and PDF. Give doc_id, or course and kind (and class_uid for a lecture or a seminar), or kind guide alone.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

class_uid.description: a RUZ class of the course, from list_classes: classes[].uid

offset.description: the character a long text starts at: next_offset of the previous call; 0 by default

max_chars.description: characters of text at most, 30000 by default

name: get_cheatsheet
title: A course's cheat sheet
description: Call this before solving or helping with any homework, assignment, problem sheet or exercise of a course, and before writing any of its documents. The course's cheat sheet, Markdown kept for Claude: the course's own notation and the topics covered so far; null when there is none yet. Keep to it. The guide (the rules of every document, as get_guide gives it) comes with it: follow it when writing a document. Its rule that a seminar's problems are not solved is about documents, not about helping with homework.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

offset.description: the character a long text starts at: next_offset of the previous call; 0 by default

name: get_guide
title: The knowledge base guide
description: The guide: the rules every document of the knowledge base is written by, Markdown kept for Claude and the owner (what goes into the book, a lecture's and a seminar's document and a cheat sheet; the LaTeX layout and preamble; the language and the style). Read it before writing or changing any document; when the owner asks to change a rule, publish a new version of it (start_document_version, kind guide). null when there is none yet.

offset.description: the character a long text starts at: next_offset of the previous call; 0 by default

name: add_material
title: Add a raw item
description: Add a text, a link or a file. text: notes, a text, or a transcript (kind transcript, with parent: the recording's id). url: a link, remembered and never fetched. file_name: a file to upload (a recording, a photo, slides, a transcript file): the item is made as a draft and the answer has a signed upload link of 6 hours and the curl command (curl -T) that sends the file; it is listed once the bytes are in. Without course and class_uid it goes to the inbox.

file_name.description: the file's name with its extension

media_type.description: the file's type; guessed from file_name if left out

kind.description: guessed when left out: from the file's type, or text, or link

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

class_uid.description: a RUZ class of the course, from list_classes: classes[].uid

author.description: who wrote or sent it: owner, a classmate's name, a chat

parent.description: the item it belongs to: a transcript's recording

name: sort_material
title: Sort raw items
description: Put items (of the inbox, or wrongly placed) into a course and a class. class_uid: that class (its course follows); course alone: the course as a whole, no class; course null: back to the inbox; class_uid null: keep the course, no class.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

class_uid.description: a RUZ class of the course, from list_classes: classes[].uid

name: update_material
title: Change a raw item
description: Change an item's title, kind, author, note, status (new or processed), or the words of a text item.

id.description: the item's id, from list_materials: items[].id

author.description: who wrote or sent it: owner, a classmate's name, a chat

name: remove_material
title: Remove raw items
description: Remove an item (id), or several at once (ids), with the transcripts on them, from every list; the owner can bring them back for 30 days.

id.description: the item's id, from list_materials: items[].id

name: start_document_version
title: Start a document version
description: Start a new version of a document: kind book (the whole course), lecture or seminar (one class: class_uid), cheatsheet (Markdown for Claude, no PDF), or guide (the rules of every document, Markdown, no PDF, no course). Write a document by the guide (get_guide). A seminar's document is its sheet's topics and the notions new in it, explained; its problems are NOT solved. materials: the ids of the items it is made from; publishing marks the new ones processed. The source may come inline (source_text: a cheat sheet, the guide, or anything from a client without a shell); for each missing part (the source, the PDF) the answer has a signed upload link of 6 hours and its curl command (source_file and pdf_file: your local paths, only to write the commands). The PDF is built where you run, or on the server by build_document_version. Then publish_document_version. A draft is seen by no one and is dropped after a day.

course.description: the course as list_library names it (the timetable's name); another name of it (a chat's) is mapped

class_uid.description: a RUZ class of the course, from list_classes: classes[].uid

name: build_document_version
title: Build a draft's PDF on the server
description: Build the PDF of a draft (a book, a lecture, a seminar) from its LaTeX source on the server, with XeLaTeX and the fonts of the guide, so a client without a shell can publish. source_text replaces the draft's source first (the way to fix it after a failed build). The source is one .tex file: no pictures, no bibliography, no other files. One build at a time, under a minute. built: false gives TeX's errors; fix the source and build again. Then publish_document_version. A PDF built where you run and uploaded by the draft's link is taken as well.

annotations.title: Build a draft's PDF on the server

name: publish_document_version
title: Publish a document version
description: Make a draft whose parts are uploaded (the source, and the PDF but for a cheat sheet or the guide) the document's newest version; earlier versions are kept. The items it names become processed.
